newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Jan wage inflation 4.5 pct, Feb 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italian Jan wage inflation 4.5 pct, Feb 4.5 pct.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an annual 4.5 percent in January and 4.5 per cent in February, statistics institute ISTAT said in a statement.
ITALY HOURLY WAGE INFLATION Feb 97 Jan 97 Dec 96

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector rose 1.3 percent year-on-year in January and in February, 4.2 percent in the industrial sector in both months, 2.5 percent in the chemical sector in both months, 4.6 percent in the metalworkers sector in both months, 3.0 percent in the service sector in both months and 1.5 percent in the transport and communications sector in both months.
In the public administration sector, wage inflation rose 7.0 percent year-on-year in January and 7.1 percent in February.
The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in January was 2.1 million hours from 0.3 million in January 1996. It gave no figure for February.
